phonecall#2.text: Why did you leave me, Daniel?

open-vo#0.text: Eleven years. I stopped counting after the first.

open-vo#1.text: Em was eight. She followed me everywhere, and I let her.

open-vo#2.text: I told myself it was only a house.

return-vo#0.text: The same gate. The same crooked step.

return-vo#1.text: Nobody has lived here for years. So why is there a light on?

birthday#0.text: Right, everyone. Candles. Say cheese, Em.

birthday#1.text: Dan-Dan, blow with me! It's the bestest cake!

birthday#2.text: You blow, it's your birthday. I'll hold the plate.

birthday#3.text: 'Cause I want you to. Pinky promise you'll do it with me.

birthday#4.text: Pinky promise. Go on, make a wish.

christmas#0.text: Dan-Dan, look, look, LOOK! Santa ate the carrot!

christmas#1.text: It's just a carrot, Em. Mum probably did it.

christmas#2.text: No she didn't! I'm not mad at you for saying it, but she didn't.

christmas#3.text: Can you read me the story tonight? The bestest one?

em3#0.text: Okay, recording. This is Emily, and I'm eight. Dan-Dan, say hi.

em3#2.text: But you promised. You pinky promised we'd play the spy game after dinner.

em3#3.text: I never said after dinner. I said maybe.

em3#5.text: Leave me alone, Em! I'm not your babysitter!

em3#7.text: Mum's not here. Fine. Tell her.

em3#8.text: I'm recording that you were mean. Recording that you were mean. Dan-Dan? Dan-Dan?

fake#2.text: It was nobody's fault. You were only a child.

fake#3.text: Do you remember the bestest birthday, Dan-Dan?

fake#4.text: Stay here with me, and don't remember the rest.

mem-sibling-photo#1.text: She never walked anywhere with me. She ran, to keep up.

mem-teddy#0.text: I sewed that ear on at the kitchen table. She watched every stitch, and told me I was doing it wrong.

mem-drawing#0.text: That's you, and that's me, and that's Mummy and Daddy. We're all holding hands.

mem-drawing#1.text: We were always holding hands, in her drawings.

mem-santa#0.text: And one for Dan-Dan too. I'll write it small, so Santa doesn't run out of room.

mem-school#0.text: Front row, grinning. I was happy then. We all were.

mem-chart#0.text: I read the most! Mrs Hale said so. I read the most in the whole class.

mem-calendar#0.text: Daniel in charge. Mum wrote it with two exclamation marks. She thought it was funny.

mem-estate#0.text: Mum and Dad stopped speaking about it. Then they stopped speaking. Then the house just stood here, waiting to be sold.

room-foyer#0.text: Dad's coat is still on the hook. Eleven years, and nobody moved it.

room-living#0.text: Sunday afternoons in here. Dad with the paper, Mum with her feet up, Em lying on the rug drawing on the back of the post.

room-kitchen#0.text: Mum always left a note by the kettle. For years I thought that was what a family sounded like. Notes, and the kettle.

room-emily#0.text: They never cleared it. Of course they didn't.

msgs12#0.text: Hello, it's Mrs Hale from school. Just to say the reading charts go home Friday, and Emily has read the most books in her class. Wonderful.

msgs12#1.text: Hello, poppets, it's Nana. Ring me on Sunday, and tell Em I found the book she wanted.

msg3#0.text: Daniel? It's Dad. Pick up if you're there.

msg3#1.text: Daniel? Okay. We're leaving at nine, we'll bring chips. Tell Em we love her. Bye.

matron-hall#0.text: You have been walking such a long time, Daniel.

matron-hall#1.text: Come away from those papers. They only make you sad.

matron-living#0.text: I kept everything exactly as you left it.

matron-living#1.text: Nobody blames you here. Nobody ever has.

matron-living#2.text: Sit down. Let me take that weight.

matron-gift#0.text: That was not kind, taking my gift apart.

matron-gift#1.text: I only wanted you to rest.

matron-truth#0.text: You were upstairs. You were asleep. You did not hear a thing.

matron-truth#1.text: Say it was an accident, Daniel. Say it, and rest.

matron-lamp#0.text: Stand in the light as long as you like, Daniel. I am very patient.

matron-caught#0.text: There. You see? It is quiet, when you stop looking.

matron-night#0.text: Leave the evening alone, Daniel. It is an old dark thing, and you will have to carry it for ever.

matron-door#0.text: You may leave whenever you like.

matron-door#1.text: Say it was an accident, and the door will open.

whisper-promise#0.text: Pinky promise. Promise. Pinky promise. Promise.

dictaphone#1.text: Anna says Daniel was in the house. She says we're not to ask him.

dictaphone#2.text: I keep going to the stairs to check on Emily, like it's a normal morning.

dictaphone#3.text: Best leave it. For Daniel. Best leave it.
